checks.text: The page displays the heading "Family Tree Visualizer" and, with no people added, shows the text "No people yet" in the list area.

In the "Add Person" form, typing "Alice" in the field labelled "Name", "1980-05-15" in the field labelled "Birth date", and clicking the button "Add person" adds a list item containing "Alice" and "b. 1980-05-15"; the text "No people yet" is removed.

After adding Alice, clicking the button "Add child" next to Alice's list item opens a form; typing "Bob" in "Name" and "2010-03-22" in "Birth date" and clicking "Add person" adds a list item containing "Bob" and "b. 2010-03-22", and the TreeOutline shows "Bob" indented under "Alice".
Clicking the button "Delete Alice" removes Alice and her child Bob from the list; the list area again shows "No people yet".
Clicking the tab labelled "Graph" switches the main view to the NodeGraph; with Alice and Bob added, the graph displays two nodes labelled "Alice" and "Bob" connected by an edge.
In the Graph view, clicking the button "Auto-layout" rearranges the nodes so that "Alice" appears above "Bob" in the vertical position.
In the Graph view, clicking the button "Export JSON" copies a JSON string to the clipboard that contains `"name":"Alice"` and `"name":"Bob"`.
After adding Alice (1980-05-15) and Bob (2010-03-22), the list item for Bob displays the age text "14 years" calculated from the current date using dateMath.
Reload keeps the people added: after adding "Alice" with birth date "1980-05-15" and reloading the page, the list still shows a list item containing "Alice" and "b. 1980-05-15".
